ActualTransport: IPv4 loopback TCP endpoints in one console process
Scope: Actual pure CLR and IPv4 loopback TCP fixtures, including production cargo projection, assembler, session and CargoInventoryController. Each member retains separate capacity, ledger weight, reservations and tracked confirmed products. Full room revisions cover non-BagRevision changes; bounded atomic batches, replay/identity fences, fair scheduling, slow publishers, scene persistence and disconnect retention are exercised. Inputs and native capability facts are synthetic CLR data. No native producer creates or attaches an authoritative expedition in the game, and no capture, bag diversion, capacity routing, storage, save, world adoption or two-game gameplay executes. Ledger weights are historical observations and host inventory is tracked-only. Complete M3-M7 and per-person bag gameplay, return and GitHub cold setup remain required.
